title: How to Convert Social Media Videos to MP3 Without an App
description: How to convert TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and X videos to MP3 without an app. Paste the link into I Need Save, choose 192 kbps MP3 audio, then save it.
photoCaption: An MP3 ready to play on any device.
photo2Caption: Choose MP3 when you only need the sound.
body:
Sometimes what you want from a video isn't the picture but the sound. It might be a catchy background song, a podcast clip or a recorded talk you'd like to play while driving. Instead of saving the whole video and using up storage, you can convert social media videos to MP3 right from your browser with I Need Save. No extra app, no login, and it's free.

Why Save It as Audio?

There are a few reasons why an audio format is often more practical:

  • Smaller files. Audio files are much lighter than videos, so your phone storage lasts longer.
  • Plays anywhere. MP3 is recognized by almost every music player, on phones and computers alike.
  • Easy listening. You can listen while doing other things without having to look at the screen.

Which Platforms Can You Get Audio From?

I Need Save works with public posts from many platforms, including TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), Pinterest, Snapchat Spotlight, Tumblr, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Twitch clips, SoundCloud, Dailymotion, Imgur, 9GAG and Streamable. For Instagram, keep in mind that the platform sometimes blocks requests or asks for a login.

As a side note, YouTube, Reddit and Vimeo are currently not supported because those platforms block the server.

How to Convert a Video to MP3, Step by Step

The process is the same for every supported platform:

  1. Open the social media app and find the video whose sound you want to keep.
  2. Tap the Share button, then choose Copy link.
  3. Open your browser and go to ineedsave.com.
  4. Paste the link into the box, or tap the Paste button.
  5. Press Download and wait until the list of options appears.
  6. In the Audio section, choose MP3 192 kbps or the original-quality audio.
  7. Wait a moment. If the button shows Preparing…, the file is being processed and the download will start automatically once it's ready.

Done! The audio file is now saved on your device.

Original Audio or 192 kbps MP3: Which Should You Pick?

The Audio section usually offers two kinds of options. Each has its own advantages.

Original-quality audio

This is the sound exactly as the platform provides it, without being converted again. Choose it if you want the audio quality to stay as it was.

MP3 192 kbps

This option is converted from the video into MP3 format at a bitrate of 192 kbps. Its strength is compatibility: MP3 plays on almost every device and music app, including older car stereos and speakers.

Tip: If you're not sure, go with the 192 kbps MP3. It sounds good for both music and speech, and it's the easiest format to play anywhere.

Ideas for Using Your MP3 Files

Once you have the audio file, there are lots of ways to enjoy it:

  • Listen offline. Play it while traveling or in places with a weak signal without using up mobile data.
  • Learn on the go. Save lesson clips, interviews or tips you find on social media, then listen while cooking or working out.
  • Personal archive. Keep memorable recordings, such as messages from family members shared on a public account.

Because the files are small, you can keep lots of audio without worrying about your storage filling up fast.

Where Are MP3 Files Saved?

  • Android and computer: files go to the Downloads folder. You can open them with a file manager or a music player app.
  • iPhone/iPad (Safari): files go to the Files app, in the Downloads folder. You can play them right from there.

Need a more detailed guide to file locations? Read our article on where downloaded files are saved.

Files are streamed directly from the original platform to your device and are not stored on the I Need Save server.

If the Audio Option Doesn't Appear or Fails

A few situations stop the audio from being fetched:

  • The video comes from a private account.
  • The content can only be viewed after logging in.
  • The content is restricted to certain regions.
  • The link comes from a platform that isn't supported yet.

Try copying the link again straight from the Share button, then repeat the process.

Respect Music Copyright

Songs and sound recordings are protected by copyright. Use the audio files you download for your own listening only. If you want to reuse them in other content, ask the owner for permission and give clear credit.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a converter app?

No. The MP3 conversion happens right in I Need Save, so all you need is a browser.

Can I get the audio from a TikTok video?

Yes. The steps are the same; just choose the Audio option after pressing Download. If you want to save the video too, see how to download TikTok videos without watermark.

What quality is the MP3?

MP3 files are converted at a bitrate of 192 kbps. If you want the sound without conversion, choose the original-quality audio.
